title: HLS Metadata Record
description: Bridges an ACSL-annotated C function to the RTL Bambu generated for it: which RTL signal each C name became, the clock/reset/handshake protocol, and the fixed-vs-variable latency. This is what gets fed to the LLM alongside the C contract so it can write SVA against real signal names instead of guessing.

source_file.description: Path to the ACSL-annotated C source, relative to repo root.

rtl_file.description: Path to the Bambu-generated Verilog, relative to repo root.

verilog_name.description: The module name exactly as it appears after 'module' in the RTL (without the leading backslash/trailing space of a Verilog escaped identifier, if any).

escaped.description: True if Bambu emitted this as a Verilog escaped identifier (e.g. '\abs '). Code that binds assertions to this module must reproduce the escape syntax exactly or the bind will not match.

contract.description: The ACSL contract, split clause-by-clause so each clause can map to one generated assertion instead of the LLM inventing its own split.

reset_polarity.description: Determined from the controller FSM's reset branch, e.g. 'if (reset == 1'b0) ... <= RESET_STATE' means active_low. Gets the disable iff(...) direction right in generated SVA.

handshake.description: The protocol that marks when inputs are consumed and when the output is valid -- the mechanism that turns an untimed C postcondition into a clocked RTL assertion.

start.description: Signal that tells the block to begin, e.g. 'start_port'.

done.description: Signal that marks outputs valid, e.g. 'done_port'. Postcondition assertions should be gated on this signal.

timing.description: Whether the block takes a fixed, known number of cycles from start to done, or a data-dependent number -- derived by reading the controller FSM, not assumed.

fixed_cycles.description: Cycle count from start_port asserted to done_port asserted, when latency_type is 'fixed'. Null otherwise.

evidence.description: Plain-text note on how fixed_cycles/latency_type was determined (e.g. FSM state count, presence of datapath registers), so the number is traceable rather than asserted blindly.

parameters.description: One entry per C function argument: the C name/type next to the RTL port it became.

rtl_port.description: Actual port name in the RTL top module.

signed.description: Signedness from the C type -- NOT from the Verilog 'signed' keyword, since Bambu's top-level ports are frequently declared as plain (unsigned) vectors even for signed C ints. Assertions must wrap with $signed(...) when this is true.

kind.description: 'scalar' for the current benchmarks; 'pointer'/'array' reserved for future benchmarks that need the memory[] section populated.

rtl_port.description: RTL port carrying the C return value, e.g. 'return_port'. ACSL's \result maps here.

memory.description: Reserved for array/pointer arguments: address/data/write-enable port mapping. Empty for scalar-only benchmarks.

extraction_method.description: How this file was produced: e.g. a static parse of the RTL's top module + controller FSM, vs. a Bambu scheduling report.
